description: Versioned provider capabilities, bounded collection samples for Channel Footprint. Native date/activity scopes are conservative: a query country never narrows global ad-level dates. A response may supply explicit native country scope; source/API documentation must justify that field.

google_ads.note: Domain-keyed Google Ads Transparency Center rows (destination-verified by construction).

capabilities.placement: explicit native placement only; VIDEO/IMAGE are formats

meta_ads.note: Public Meta Ad Library page search, one brand per run: the actor serves one search URL per run reliably (observed live 2026-10-02); identity verified by destination domain or page name.

linkedin_ads.note: LinkedIn Ad Library by company page URL (slug read from the competitor's own site, brand token as fallback); rows are attributed by the query they came from and checked against the advertiser name.

tiktok_ads.note: EU/EEA transparency examples by advertiser; check each explicit supported target country; unsupported markets remain gaps, not proxies.

reddit_ads.note: Inspiration examples only. Zero or old examples leave current campaigns not_verifiable; operator found no accessible campaign library.

traffic_mix.note: Public Similarweb overview per domain: monthly visits and the traffic-source share split. Used only while the SimilarWeb tools provider is not configured.

pixel_detector.note: Headless fallback for sites whose HTML cannot be fetched directly; opt-in through --pixel-actor-fallback.

budget.note: Default cumulative cap equals the bounded plan including scoped sample expansion and a separate retry reserve; metered starts and retries persist across invocations.
